title: Transfer equilibrium hazard after coherent release with a paid support-size bound
statement: An arbitrary CPTP release supported on F and a thermal syndrome marginal obey mu_F(b)<=sum_{u in U_F}pi(b+u)<=[4 exp(beta c_E)]^|F| pi(b). Stationarity, positivity and the accepted complete logical-hazard reduction give error(t)<=initial decoded error+2t[4 exp(beta c_E)]^|F| pi(h), retaining logical/reference correlations. With C_beta=4 exp(beta c_E)>1 and equilibrium hazard pi(h)<=poly(N) exp(-c N^alpha), the same actual reference-safe support bound gives error(t)<=initial decoded error+2t poly(N) exp(-c N^alpha/2) for every supported coherent CPTP release satisfying |F|<=c N^alpha/[2 log C_beta]. This is genuine subextensive-support retention, conditional on the stated hazard and initial decoded error; it is not the constant-positive-density acquired writer law. For iid site faults, E[C_beta^|F|]=(1-p+p C_beta)^N still grows exponentially at fixed p>0.
